model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Тази графика илюстрира промените в максималната стойност на активация за различни базови линии в зависимост от слоя.

Оста X е обозначена като "Layer" и използва линейна скала с диапазон от 0 до 22. Етикетите са разположени на интервали от 5, като стойностите са 0, 5, 10, 15 и 20.

Оста Y е обозначена като "Max Activation Value" и също използва линейна скала с диапазон от 0 до 1600. Етикетите са разположени на интервали от 200, като стойностите са 0, 200, 400, 600, 800, 1000, 1200, 1400 и 1600.

Графиката съдържа четири линии, всяка от които представлява различен тип данни: 
- attn_output (синя, пунктирана линия)
- attn_residual (оранжев, пунктиран линия)
- ffn_output (зелена, прекъсната линия)
- ffn_residual (червена, непрекъсната линия)

В началото на оста X, около слой 0, всички линии показват стойности близки до 0. 
Около слой 5 се наблюдава рязко увеличение на стойностите за повечето линии. 
Линиите attn_residual и ffn_residual достигат високи стойности около 1400-1500 между слоеве 5 и 20. 
Линията ffn_output показва значителни колебания, особено около слой 20, където има рязък пик. 
Линията attn_output остава близка до 0 през повечето слоеве, с рязко увеличение към края, около слой 20.

Тази графика показва детайлен изглед на това как максималната стойност на активация се променя през различните слоеве за всяка от четирите групи данни.
model_annotations.Chinese:
The graph displays the maximum activation values across different layers for four distinct lines: attn_output, attn_residual, ffn_output, and ffn_residual. 

The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and has a range from 0 to around 23, with numerical tick marks at intervals of 5, starting from 0.

The y-axis is labeled "Max Activation Value" and spans from 0 to 1600, with numerical tick marks at intervals of 200.

The attn_output line is blue and dashed, starting near 0 at layer 0, remaining near 0 until layer 5, and then sharply increasing to around 150 at layer 23. 

The attn_residual line is orange and dotted, beginning near 0 at layer 0, sharply increasing to about 1450 at layer 5, remaining relatively stable until layer 16, then decreasing to around 100 at layer 21, before increasing to about 1500 at layer 22 and sharply decreasing to around 200 at layer 23.

The ffn_output line is green and dash-dotted, starting near 0 at layer 0, sharply increasing to approximately 1400 at layer 5, fluctuating with a peak of around 1200 at layer 14, then decreasing to about 50 at layer 20, before increasing to around 900 at layer 22 and decreasing to around 200 at layer 23.

The ffn_residual line is red and solid, beginning near 0 at layer 0, sharply increasing to about 1450 at layer 5, remaining relatively stable with minor fluctuations until layer 20, then decreasing to around 50 at layer 21, before sharply increasing to around 1200 at layer 22 and decreasing to about 700 at layer 23.
model_annotations.English: This plot illustrates the massive activation of baseline across different layers, comparing four distinct lines. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," has a linear scale with a range of 0 to 21, marked with tick labels at every integer value. The y-axis, labeled "Max Activation Value," also has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 1600, with tick labels at every 200 units. The plot features four lines: "attn_output" in blue with a dashed line style and no markers, "attn_residual" in orange with a dotted line style and no markers, "ffn_output" in green with a dash-dot line style and no markers, and "ffn_residual" in red with a solid line style and no markers. The "attn_output" line remains near 0 across all layers, starting at 0 and ending at 100. The "attn_residual" line starts near 0 at layer 0, sharply increases to 1400 at layer 5, remains steady until layer 17, then drops to 400 at layer 21. The "ffn_output" line begins at 0, spikes to 1400 at layer 5, fluctuates slightly between layers 6 and 17, and then sharply declines to 100 at layer 21. The "ffn_residual" line starts at 25, rapidly increases to 1500 at layer 5, remains relatively constant until layer 17, and then abruptly drops to 600 at layer 21.
model_annotations.German: The diagram displays the massive activation of baseline values across different layers for four distinct lines: attn_output, attn_residual, ffn_output, and ffn_residual. The y-axis, labeled "Max Activation Value," features a linear scale with values ranging from 0 to 1600, marked with tick labels at regular intervals of 200 units. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," has a linear scale spanning from 0 to 23, with tick labels at regular intervals of 5 units. The attn_output line is represented by a blue dashed line with circular markers; it begins at approximately 10 on the y-axis at layer 0 and remains at 0 until layer 4, then increases to around 100 by layer 23. The attn_residual line is depicted as an orange dotted line with square markers; it starts at approximately 10 on the y-axis at layer 0, sharply increases to around 1400 by layer 5, and then gradually decreases to about 1500 by layer 20, before dropping to around 1200 by layer 23. The ffn_output line is shown as a green dash-dot line with triangular markers; it begins at approximately 10 on the y-axis at layer 0, increases to around 1400 by layer 5, then sharply decreases to about 100 by layer 6, and remains relatively stable near 0 until layer 20, where it increases to around 1200 by layer 23. The ffn_residual line is illustrated as a red solid line with diamond markers; it starts at approximately 10 on the y-axis at layer 0, sharply increases to around 1500 by layer 5, and remains relatively stable until layer 20, where it drops to around 500 by layer 23.
